transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because for a long time now, I've just had this heavy, low feeling sitting on me most days. I still get through my driving routes and my volunteer shifts fine, but... it's like I’m just going through the motions instead of really being in my own life. I just figured it was time to talk to somebody about it.
You mentioned feeling this way for a long time—about how many months or years has this been going on?
It's been about three years now. It started right around the time my father died, and it just hasn't really lifted since then.
During these past three years, have there been any periods lasting more than two months where you felt completely back to your normal self?

No, not really. I mean, I've had a good day here or there, maybe a decent weekend where things felt a little lighter, but... no. It's never gone away for a whole two months. It's always just kind of there in the background.
Before your father passed away three years ago, had you ever experienced a period of depression like this in your life?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I was sad or stressed out about work or life stuff, just like anybody else, but... nothing like this. This heavy feeling that just sticks around day after day, that's new since he passed.
How has your sleep been over these past three years?

It's been pretty rough, honestly. Especially on nights before a run. I’ll just lie there thinking about all the next day’s stops, or... or I'll wake up around four in the morning and not really get back to sleep. So, even when I make it to work on time, I just feel like I’m starting the day already worn down.
How has your appetite been over these past few years?

It's been pretty normal, honestly. I haven't really noticed any changes with that. I still eat about the same as I always have... grab something on the road during my shift, have dinner when I get back. So, yeah, eating hasn't really been a problem.
Over these past few years, have you found yourself feeling hopeless about the future?

No, I wouldn't say hopeless. I mean, I know I've got to keep working and paying the bills, and I don't think things are doomed or anything like that. It's just... more of a struggle to get through the day-to-day right now. But no, I don't really feel hopeless about the future.
Have you noticed that your energy levels are consistently low or that you feel fatigued most days?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... besides being tired in the morning from not sleeping great sometimes, my energy itself is usually okay. Once I get my coffee and get going on my route, I can push through just fine. I don't really feel wiped out or fatigued all day or anything like that.
How have you been feeling about yourself lately, in terms of your self-esteem or self-worth?

Honestly, not that great. I just... I keep comparing myself to the kind of man my dad was. Nobody is actually telling me I'm failing at things, but I just hear it in my own head all the time. I just feel like at my age, I should be further along by now, and I should be handling things a lot better than this.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually hyper, energized, or on top of the world for days at a time?

No, I can't say I've ever felt like that. I mean, I have good days where work goes smooth and I'm in a decent mood, but nothing where I'm bouncing off the walls or feeling like I'm on top of the world. Just normal good days, I guess. Nothing unusual.
